description: This PHP source file defines the VueControllerHelper class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides helper methods for assembling context parameters required for rendering Vue.js components, including user info, menu items, theme data, breadcrumbs, and permissions. The class uses multiple traits for modular functionality and interacts with core services and entities to gather data.

classes.name: VueControllerHelper
classes.description: Helper class for assembling Vue.js component context data, including user info, menu items, theme data, breadcrumbs, permissions, and other UI parameters.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP request object.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the current HTTP request object.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the current Vue component object.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Builds and returns an array of context parameters for Vue components, including user details, menus, theme, and permissions.

methods.name: getAssetsVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current assets version based on build timestamp.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the current logged-in user's ID.

methods.name: getUserObject
methods.description: Builds a user info array with name, profile image URL, and password status.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves main menu items and top menu items; handles exceptions.

methods.name: getContextItems
methods.description: Gets current screen context info like screen name and icon.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Initializes or returns the ScreenPermissionService instance.

methods.name: getBreadcrumb
methods.description: Constructs breadcrumb navigation data based on current module and screen.

methods.name: getThemeData
methods.description: Retrieves theme-related URLs and variables for the UI.

methods.name: getHelpUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL to the help documentation for the current screen.
